title: What element am I? Free fire, water, earth or air quiz — cv.cm
description: Free element quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if your personality is fire, water, earth or air, with your scores for all four. Just for fun; no sign-up, answers stay in your browser.
lede: Bold like fire, deep like water, steady like earth or free like air? Answer 12 questions about how you think, feel and recharge to find your element.
about: The idea that everything is made of four elements, fire, water, earth and air, goes back to the Greek philosopher Empedocles in the 5th century BC and was taken up by Aristotle. For centuries it shaped medicine, alchemy and astrology, where each zodiac sign belongs to an element and the elements stand for temperaments: fire for energy and passion, water for feeling and intuition, earth for patience and practicality, air for ideas and connection. Chemistry has long since replaced it, but the four elements are still a popular way to describe personality. China's five phases (wood, fire, earth, metal and water) are a different system.

This quiz was written for cv.cm and has nothing to do with your birthday or star sign: it matches you to an element from how you answer. Every question offers each element once, so each result is equally likely. It's just for fun.

faq.a: Fire, water, earth and air, the classical elements of ancient Greek philosophy. In personality terms, fire is passion, water is feeling, earth is stability and air is ideas.

faq.q: Is my element the same as my zodiac element?
faq.a: Not necessarily. In astrology your element comes from your star sign; here it comes from your answers, so it shows the element your personality leans toward.

faq.q: Which zodiac signs go with each element?
faq.a: Fire: Aries, Leo and Sagittarius. Earth: Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn. Air: Gemini, Libra and Aquarius. Water: Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces.

faq.q: Is one result rarer than the others?
faq.a: Every element appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

fire.name: Fire
fire.body: You're bold, passionate and full of energy. You act fast, you inspire people and you light up any room you walk into. You'd rather try and fail than never try. Your fire can burn hot, so make room for rest and patience, and you'll keep that spark for the long run. Astrology's fire signs are Aries, Leo and Sagittarius.

water.name: Water
water.body: You're intuitive, caring and deep. You feel things strongly, you understand people without being told and friends come to you for comfort. Like water, you adapt to whatever shape life takes. Protect your energy and say what you need, too. Astrology's water signs are Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces.

earth.name: Earth
earth.body: You're steady, practical and dependable. You like plans, routines and getting things done, and people trust you because you follow through. You're patient and grounded, and you enjoy the simple things. Leave a little room for spontaneity; not everything needs a plan. Astrology's earth signs are Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn.

air.name: Air
air.body: You're curious, social and full of ideas. You love learning, talking and seeing things from new angles, and you bring fresh thinking wherever you go. You need freedom and variety. Grounding your best ideas with a plan will help them take off. Astrology's air signs are Gemini, Libra and Aquarius.
